levels.name: Pre A1 Starters
levels.desc: Bài thi đầu tiên của Cambridge cho trẻ nhỏ: nghe tên và số, nối tranh, đọc câu ngắn và viết từ đơn giản.

tests.title: Practice Test 1

parts.inst: Listen and match. There is one example.
script: Look at the photo of the party, Pat.
Oh yes! Who is Pat in this photo, Dad?
Pat is taking a photo. She has a new camera.
Sue is eating a big piece of cake.
Ann is dancing. She loves to dance.
Lucy is blowing a red balloon.
Is Nick the boy with the guitar?
Yes, he is playing the guitar. It is very loud!
Jill is giving a present to her friend.

parts.inst: Read the question. Listen and write a name or a number.

items.q: What is the teacher's name? Mr ______
How many children are in the class? ______
What is the number of the bus? ______
What is the girl's phone number? ______

script: Hello! You are in my class, aren't you? What's your teacher's name?
How many children are in the class?
Do you come to school by bus?
Yes, I take the number fifteen.
Can I have your phone number?
Great. And do you have a pet?
Yes, a dog. His name is Max.

parts.inst: Listen and choose the right answer (A, B or C). There is one example.

items.q: What does Ben want for lunch?
What is the weather like today?
How does Anna go to school?
What colour is Tom's new bag?

script: Ben, what would you like for lunch? Pizza?
No, thanks, Mum. I'd like a sandwich, please.
Look! It is under the table.
No, it isn't sunny and it isn't rainy. It is windy!
Anna, do you come to school by bike?
No, I walk. It is only five minutes.
Tom, I like your new bag. Is it blue?

parts.inst: Listen and colour. Write the colour next to each thing. There is one example.
script: Look at this picture. The coat is orange.
Now, take your pencil. Colour the hat red.
Now the ball. I want a yellow ball.
And the kite. Colour the kite pink.

parts.inst: Read the text. Choose Yes or No. There is one example.

items.q: Tom's house is far from the sea.
Tom walks on the beach in the morning.

parts.text: Tom lives in a small house near the sea. He has a dog called Max. Every morning Tom and Max walk on the beach. Tom's sister, Lily, is six. She likes drawing pictures of boats.

parts.inst: Look and read. Choose the right words from the box.

items.q: You open this to get fresh air in your room.
This animal has long ears and likes carrots.
You sleep in this at night.
This person works in a school and helps children learn.

ex: It is a red or green fruit.

parts.inst: Read the conversations. Choose the right answer (A, B or C).

You can read this. b _ _ k
It is a big animal with a long nose. e _ e p _ _ n t

Who is wearing a blue hat?

levels.name: A1 Movers
levels.desc: Cấp độ giữa: nghe ghi chú, đọc đoạn văn ngắn, điền từ vào truyện và viết câu đơn giản.

tests.title: Practice Test 1

parts.inst: Listen and match. There is one example.
script: Look at the photo of our sports day. Who is Grace?
Grace is waving a flag near the gate.
He is running very fast. He wants to win.
Emma is jumping over the rope. She is good at that.
He is throwing the ball to his friend.
Zoe is tying her shoe. It came undone!
Max is very thirsty. He is drinking some water.

parts.inst: Listen and write. There is one example.
script: Hello, class. This is about our trip to the Science Museum.
We are going on the twelfth of May.
What time does the bus leave?
At eight forty-five, so please be on time.
Yes, a camera is a good idea, but no phones, please.
And who is coming with us?

parts.inst: Where did Sam go? Listen and write a letter next to each day.
script: Sam, what did you do last week?
On Saturday we went to the beach, it was great.
On Monday I went to the library to find a book.
Yes, on Tuesday I went to the swimming pool with my cousin.
Mum and I went to the market to buy fruit.
I watched a funny film at the cinema.
On Friday I visited my grandmother. We made a cake.

parts.inst: Listen and choose the right answer (A, B or C).

items.q: What time does the film start?
What does Mum want to buy?
Which sport does Ben like best?
What is Lisa going to wear to the party?

script: What time does the film start?
Not at six. It starts at a quarter past six.
Mum, shall I go to the shop?
Yes please. I need some milk. We have bread and cheese already.
It's OK, but I like tennis best. Football is boring for me.
I left it in the car... no, wait, it's on the sofa.
Lisa, are you wearing your red dress to the party?
No, the blue one is too small. I'll wear my new yellow dress.

parts.inst: Read the descriptions. Choose a word from the box.

items.q: People buy this to travel by train.
You wear this around your neck when it is cold.
This person works with animals and plants on a farm.
This is a very high hill.
You can use this to climb up to a roof.

ex: This is land with water all around it.

parts.inst: Complete the conversations. Choose A, B or C.

items.q: How often do you play tennis?
Would you like some more soup?
Where did you go on holiday?
o: A  We went to the sea.

parts.inst: Read the story and choose the right words from the box.
parts.text: Last Sunday my family went to the (1) ______. It was hot, so my brother and I wanted to (2) ______ in the sea. Mum said, "Wait! First put on your hats (3) ______ the sun is strong." After swimming, we were very (4) ______, so we sat down and ate (5) ______. Then we built a big sand castle.

parts.inst: Read the text and answer the questions.

items.q: Where does Mia go on Saturdays?
Why does she like the horse called Star?
o: B  He is kind and quiet.
C  He is black and white.

items.q: What does Mia do at the end of the day?

parts.text: Mia loves animals. Every Saturday she goes to her uncle's farm with her friend Eva. First, they feed the hens and give water to the cows. Then Mia rides her favourite horse, Star. He is not very fast, but he is kind and quiet. At the end of the day, Mia sits under a tree and draws the animals in her notebook.

speaking: Two pictures that are nearly the same. The examiner describes one, the child corrects.
In my picture, the girl is wearing a red hat. (Child: In my picture, she is wearing a blue hat.)
In my picture, there are three dogs.
In my picture, the boy is eating an apple.
Child tells a story from four pictures.
Look at these pictures. They show a story. First I will tell you about picture one. Now you tell the story.
How does the boy feel at the end?
Four pictures, child finds the odd one and says why.
Tell me about the pictures: bus, bike, plane, tree.
What do you do at the weekend?

levels.name: A2 Flyers
levels.desc: Cấp độ cao nhất của bộ Young Learners, tương đương A2 Key: nghe ghi chú dài, đọc bài báo, điền từ và hội thoại.

tests.title: Practice Test 1

parts.inst: Listen and match. There is one example.
script: Welcome to summer camp! Let me tell you who is doing what. Look, Chloe is painting a picture by the lake.
Oliver is the boy on the red wall. He loves climbing.
Grace is next to the fire. She is cooking sausages for everybody.
Jake is the quiet boy under the tree. He is playing chess with the camp leader.
Emily is out on the water in the little boat. She is learning to sail.
And Dan is in the tent. He is making a model of a plane.

parts.inst: Listen and write. There is one example.
script: Hello, I want to book a place at the summer camp for my son.
Of course. Is it Camp Oakwood? That is O-A-K-W-O-O-D.
On the fourteenth of July, and it lasts for five days.
Warm clothes and a torch for the night walk.
And your phone number, in case I need you?
Zero, seven, two, three, four, five.

parts.inst: What did each person do at the weekend? Listen and write a letter.
script: What did everyone do at the weekend, Mum?
Well, your cousin Pete saw a film with his friends.
Laura visited an old castle with her class. She took lots of photos.
Did Ben go to the cinema too?
No, Ben went fishing with his dad. They caught three fish.
Hannah plays the drums, doesn't she?
Yes, she played in a band at the school party on Saturday.
Tom cleaned the car for his uncle and got some money.
Sarah baked bread with Grandma. It smelled wonderful.

parts.inst: Listen and choose the right answer (A, B or C).

items.q: What is wrong with the boy?
o: B  He has hurt his leg.
C  in front of the cinema

items.q: What present will Dad buy for Grandma?
How will they travel to the city?

script: You look unhappy, Jim. Do you have a cold?
No, I fell off my bike yesterday and hurt my leg.
Where shall we meet tomorrow, at the station?
No, let's meet outside the library. It's easier.
Have you found your keys, Anna?
They are in my pocket, but I can't find my glasses!
Dad, are you buying Grandma a book?
No, she has too many. I'll get some flowers. A scarf was my first idea.
Shall we go to the city by car?
The traffic is terrible. Let's take the train.
ex: What does Anna want to eat?

you use this to keep dry in the rain
a place where you can see old and interesting things
a book where you write about your days
you sleep in this when you camp

items.q: Would you like to come to my party on Saturday?
o: A  I'd love to, thank you.

items.q: Have you ever been to London?
How long have you lived here?
Do you mind if I open the window?

B  Of course, here it is.
B  I saw it with Sam.

parts.inst: Read the story. Choose the best word (A, B or C) for each space.
parts.text: Last weekend Jack (1) ______ very excited. He was going to the zoo for the first time, (2) ______ his aunt had bought tickets for his birthday. When he arrived, there were (3) ______ people than he expected. He (4) ______ read a lot about the animals, so he knew what to see. At lunchtime he had (5) ______ taken fifty photos!

parts.inst: Read the article and choose the right answer.

items.q: When did she show it to the class?

parts.text: Ella is twelve and she loves science. Last month she built a small robot from old parts. She wanted to help her grandfather, who finds it difficult to carry heavy shopping. Last Friday she showed the robot to her class, and everybody clapped. The teacher said it was the best project of the year. Ella is very proud and she is planning to make a bigger one.

parts.inst: Read the text and write ONE word for each space.
parts.text: Our school is at the end of (1) ______ street. It has a big garden with lots (2) ______ flowers. Yesterday it (3) ______ sunny, so we had lunch outside. I was happy (4) ______ my best friend sat next (5) ______ me.

speaking: Two pictures. The examiner describes and the child corrects.
In my picture, the man is carrying a heavy bag.
In my picture, there are two children on the beach.
In my picture, the woman is drinking tea.
